text: "Then indeed, He enticed you from the mouth of distress and confinement, Into a broad place where there is no constraint or distress; And that which was set on your table was full of fatness (rich food).
"Who has appointed God His way, And who can say [to Him], 'You have done wrong'?
"His thundering voice declares [awesomely] His presence; The cattle also are told of His coming storm.
